list.heading: Facebook and Instagram lead ads
list.intro: Answers to your lead forms become leads here by themselves, within seconds. We only read them: nothing is ever posted to your Page.
list.empty: No Page is connected. Connect the Facebook Page your lead ads run from.
list.limitHint: You can connect up to {limit} Pages. Disconnect one to connect another.
list.notSetUp: Facebook and Instagram lead ads aren't set up on this server.
list.formsBroughtIn: {count, plural, =0 {No forms brought in} one {# form brought in} other {# forms brought in}}

connect.title: Connect a Page
connect.intro: We read your lead forms' answers. We never post, message or change anything on your Page.
connect.tip: You need the Advertise role on the Page. Facebook's own window asks which Pages to share.
connect.notSetUp: Facebook and Instagram lead ads aren't set up on this server.

callback.title: Choose your Pages
callback.cancelled: Facebook didn't finish the login. Start again from Connect a Page.
callback.intro: These are the Pages you shared and can advertise on. Tick the ones to bring leads from.
callback.not_allowed: You can't advertise on this Page
callback.none: None of the Pages you shared can be connected. Connect again and share a Page you can advertise on.
callback.limit: You can connect up to {limit} Pages in all.
callback.connect: {count, plural, =0 {Connect Pages} one {Connect # Page} other {Connect # Pages}}

page.subtitle: Connected by {name} on {day}
page.late: Checks are running late. Check now reads the forms at once.

counts.heading: Since you connected
counts.notes: A person who already has a lead gets a repeat enquiry on it, not a second lead. Leads from forms you haven't brought in are not saved.

needs_reconnect.title: Facebook stopped sharing this Page
needs_reconnect.body: Its access ended, or you were removed from the Page. No new leads come in until you reconnect. Leads that came meanwhile are brought in afterwards.

expiring.title: Facebook's access for this Page ends on {day}
expiring.body: Reconnect before then, so no lead is missed.

forms.title: A form's questions changed
forms.body: Answers to a new question go to the lead's note until you match it. Open the form below and check its questions.

paused.title: This Page is paused
paused.body: New leads are not saved while it is paused. Resume reads the ones that came meanwhile.

readOnly.title: Your agency can't change anything right now
readOnly.body: Leads stop coming in until the subscription is back.

forms.heading: Lead forms
forms.intro: Bring in a form to turn its answers into leads. A form you haven't brought in saves nothing.
forms.skipped: {count, plural, one {# lead came} other {# leads came}} while this form wasn't brought in. They are brought in with it, if you ask for the last 30 days.
forms.empty: This Page has no lead forms yet. Make one in Meta Ads Manager and it appears here.

problems.heading: Leads that couldn't be added
problems.checkedMerged: Added to the lead this person already has.
problems.help: Fix what the reason says, then Check again. Facebook keeps the lead; we read it once more.

reasons.no_contact: No phone, email or Instagram handle
reasons.phone_invalid: The phone isn't a number we can use
reasons.notes_too_long: The answers are too long to keep
reasons.erased: The person asked for their data to be erased
reasons.could_not_add: We couldn't add it. Check again in a minute
reasons.lead_not_found: Facebook no longer has this lead
reasons.lead_not_allowed: Facebook wouldn't let us read this lead

disconnect.title: Stop bringing in leads from {page}?
disconnect.description: Leads already here stay. Facebook's copy is untouched. You can connect the Page again later.

bringIn.title: Match {form}
bringIn.intro: Say what each question holds. Facebook's own name, phone and email questions are matched for you.
bringIn.introQuestions: Answers are matched by Facebook's question, not its wording, so renaming a question changes nothing.
bringIn.loadFailed: We couldn't read this form's questions.

earlier.legend: Leads from before you brought the form in
earlier.onlyNew: Only new leads from now on
earlier.onlyNewHint: Nothing already at Facebook is added.
earlier.last30Hint: You'll see a preview first. Anyone who already has a lead with you is left out unless you tick them. Facebook keeps a form's leads for a limited time, so a longer look back isn't offered.

bringIn.confirmDescription: New answers become leads within seconds.

reading30.title: Reading the last 30 days
reading30.body: Getting the leads from the last 30 days from Facebook. Your preview opens in a moment.
reading30.none: No leads from the last 30 days were found to check. New answers become leads by themselves.
